# mockingbird Provider

Manages [Mockingbird](https://github.com/RJ-s-Org/Mockingbird) mocks, contracts, scenarios, LLM profiles and API keys through the Admin API, so mocked lower environments can be created from code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mockingbird = {
      source = "RJ-s-Org/mockingbird"
    }
  }
}

# Every setting can come from the environment instead:
# MB_ADMIN_URL, MB_ADMIN_TOKEN, MB_WORKSPACE and MB_DATA_PLANE_URL.
provider "mockingbird" {
  endpoint       = "http://127.0.0.1:9090"
  workspace      = "default"
  data_plane_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
  # token = var.mockingbird_token # an API key (mbk_…) or OIDC access token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_plane_url` (String) Origin the data plane is reached at, e.g. `http://mockingbird.staging:8080`. When set, `mockingbird_mock` exports `url` (this origin plus the route prefix). Defaults to `MB_DATA_PLANE_URL`.
- `endpoint` (String) Admin API origin, e.g. `https://mockingbird.staging.example.com:9090`. Defaults to `MB_ADMIN_URL`, then `http://127.0.0.1:9090`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer credential for the Admin API: an API key (`mbk_…`) or an OIDC access token. Defaults to `MB_ADMIN_TOKEN`. Not needed when the server runs with `auth.mode: none`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace that resources are created in unless they set `workspace`. Defaults to `MB_WORKSPACE`, then `default`.
